Definition: from G1965; to commit perjury:--forswear self.
BiblicalUsage: Epiorkeo means to swear falsely, to forswear oneself — and Jesus quotes the old word: Thou shalt not forswear thyself, but shalt perform unto the Lord thine oaths. Then He raises the standard higher: swear not at all.
TheologicalSignificance: Jesus is after a heart that needs no oath to be believed, I hold: let your yes be yes, and your no be no.
